replacements.before: **[Wobblini](wobblini.html)** is an eight-deck browser DJ instrument in progress: scratchable records and wide track waveforms, local files and demo loops, selectable master with per-track SYNC, cues, beat loops, EQ, filters, and a geometric stereo pan/volume mixer. Audio starts off. [Controls and MVP boundaries](docs/wobblini.md).
replacements.after: **[Wobblini](wobblini.html)** intercuts eight stereo sources with scratchable records and waveforms, cue preview, Slip, separate input gain, A/B/Thru routing, BPM analysis, optional per-track SYNC, pitch preservation and independent pitch shift. Files play through once. Browser-storage recording exports numbered WAV parts. Audio starts off. [Controls and limits](docs/wobblini.md).
